description: This file defines the FrameDispatcher class, which acts as a remote dispatcher for Frame objects in the Playwright testing framework. It implements various methods to interact with and control frames within web pages, such as navigation, element querying, evaluation, event dispatching, and more.

classes.name: FrameDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing and controlling browser frames in Playwright. It provides methods for navigation, element interaction, evaluation, and event handling within a specific frame context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a FrameDispatcher instance from a scope and frame, or returns existing dispatcher if already created.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates a FrameDispatcher if the frame is not null; otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of FrameDispatcher, setting up event listeners and frame properties.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL, returning the response.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Gets the element handle for the frame element.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression within the frame context.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element matching the selector to appear in the frame.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a specified event on an element within the frame.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Executes a function in the context of a specific element matched by selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Executes a function on all elements matched by a selector.

methods.name: querySelector

methods.name: querySelectorAll

methods.name: queryCount
